subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue deduplicate Matrix m.replace events in readMessages payloads for JSON/tool consumers, or only collapse them for CLI/display projection?
rationale: Current main clearly needs a Matrix read/pins formatter fix, but the open comprehensive PR also changes consumer-visible Matrix payload semantics in a compatibility-sensitive plugin action result.

options.title: Accept Comprehensive Matrix Fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical path if Matrix reads should expose a final edited-message view across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Dedup Display-Only
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve raw readMessages payload shape and collapse m.replace rows only in the Matrix display/projection path.

options.title: Split Blank Table From Dedup
options.body: Land a focused read/pins field projection first and track edited-message aggregation as a smaller follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Comprehensive Matrix Fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical path if Matrix reads should expose a final edited-message view across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest Matrix plugin/action-boundary and shared formatter history among the likely owners in the available local history.
